notes.subject: em
notes.rationale: Hibru i no gat kopula; Tok Pisin i needim em

notes.subject: hatpela
notes.rationale: מרי em i narapela kain — 'bitter' na 'rebelius' tupela; KJV 'bitter', ASV 'rebellious'

notes.subject: han bilong mi i heavymo
notes.rationale: ידי כבדה על אנחתי: 'han bilong mi i heavymo long singaut pen' o 'han i heavymoa singaut pen yet' — tupela lain ol man i tantim tok i no putim wanem

translation: Tasol long dispela de, tok bilong bel hevi bilong mi ⟨em⟩ i hatpela; han bilong mi i heavymo long singaut pen bilong mi.

tokens.gloss: tok bilong bel hevi bilong mi
